oily.headline: Oily Skin
oily.description: Your skin produces excess sebum, giving it a shiny appearance with enlarged pores.
oily.tip: Use oil-free, non-comedogenic products and gentle foaming cleansers.

normal.headline: Normal Skin
normal.description: Well-balanced skin with minimal oiliness, dryness, or sensitivity.
normal.tip: Maintain balance with a simple hydrating routine and daily SPF.

dry.headline: Dry Skin
dry.description: Your skin lacks sufficient moisture, leading to tightness and a dull complexion.
dry.tip: Prioritise rich moisturisers, gentle cleansers, and hyaluronic acid serums.

no_acne.headline: Clear Skin
no_acne.description: No active acne detected — your skin appears blemish-free.
no_acne.tip: Keep up your current routine and focus on prevention.

comedonal_acne.headline: Comedonal Acne
comedonal_acne.description: Blackheads and whiteheads detected, caused by clogged pores.
comedonal_acne.tip: Salicylic acid and gentle exfoliation help keep pores clear.

inflammatory_acne.headline: Inflammatory Acne
inflammatory_acne.description: Active papules or pustules detected, indicating inflamed breakouts.
inflammatory_acne.tip: Benzoyl peroxide and niacinamide calm inflammation and reduce bacteria.

hyperpigmentation.headline: Hyperpigmentation
hyperpigmentation.description: Uneven skin tone or dark spots caused by excess melanin production.
hyperpigmentation.tip: Vitamin C, niacinamide, and consistent SPF use are key to fading dark spots.

sensitive.headline: Sensitive Skin
sensitive.description: Signs of diffuse redness detected, suggesting skin reactivity or irritation.
sensitive.tip: Choose fragrance-free, hypoallergenic formulas and patch-test new products.

combination.headline: Combination Skin
combination.description: An oily T-zone (forehead, nose, chin) with relatively drier cheeks.
combination.tip: Use lightweight balancing products and consider zone-specific treatments.

severe.headline: Consult a Dermatologist
severe.description: A potentially serious skin condition was detected that requires professional evaluation.
severe.tip: Please book an appointment with a certified dermatologist as soon as possible.
